title: The Author Notebook
prompt: Use Dazzler to design the author notebook for its fictional reader task. A two-page writing notebook pairs a narrow revision margin with a broad editable manuscript; chapter context closes the desk. Retain the existing data and functional controls, with keyboard and mobile access. Use Young Serif, #2544A0 and #D3DCFF. Preserve factual caveats and local-only behavior; do not imply real booking, payment, publication or account changes.
